profile.headline: Software Engineer at AmTrust Financial Services, Inc. (AFSI)
profile.summary: I'm an experienced IT professional looking to use my technical skills in training, development and support in an environment that offers growth potential. I prefer a full-time position but will consider contract employment offers.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Provide IT training, development, or support services as requested

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Responsible for daily management of IT systems and reporting for assigned clients and new client setup using MS Office, SQL Server, and Visual Studio with SSRS reporting, ETL and SSIS packages.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Provide HWAP training, development, and support services as requested

positions.title: HWAP IT Specialist
positions.description: Responsible for providing IT services for Home Weatherization Assistance Program software including training and application development. Also serve as remote IT Help Desk Support for clients as necessary.

positions.title: Part-time Instructor - Dept of Cont Ed
positions.description: Responsible for designing the curriculum and delivering part-time educational training classes in various computer programming subjects.

positions.title: System Analyst/App Dev/Trainer
positions.description: Responsible for providing customer specific application development services in varied Microsoft technologies including Windows and Web Based applications and document management systems; teach technical training classes upon request; Help Desk Support.

positions.title: Senior Instructor
positions.description: Responsible for educational training in computer technology areas as outlined above; teach generally one to two-day classes; instruct at NH facilities as well as onsite at client locations.

volunteerExperiences.description: Five-month program for connecting with other parent leaders and building leadership skills while working to design and implement a project to improve educational opportunities in the community.
